fix_summary: TTLCache.get returns the cached value without checking whether the entry has expired. Implement a TTL check comparing time.monotonic() - stored_at against self.ttl_seconds and return None (and optionally delete the entry) when expired.
suggested_test: Create a TTLCache with ttl_seconds=1, put a key, assert get(key) returns the value immediately, then advance time past 1 second (sleep or mock time.monotonic) and assert get(key) returns None (and the entry is gone).
